attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Started Immediately After Administrator Login
attributes.description: Detects a Druva administrator login followed by restore or recovery activity by the same administrator within five minutes.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a Druva administrator login followed by restore or recovery activity by the same administrator within five minutes.

attributes.query:
sequence by user.name with maxspan=5m
  [ any where druva.feature == "Admin Event"
      and druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
      and event.outcome == "success" ]
  [ any where druva.event_type like~ ("*Recover*", "*Restore*") ]
